# Local MMDB test data

`GeoIP2-City-Test.mmdb` is MaxMind's deliberately synthetic format/reader fixture, downloaded from:
https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/blob/main/test-data/GeoIP2-City-Test.mmdb

SHA256: `ed972738e4e03a3e56e12041a6af4d91592249d110f7e4a647e5f2fa0e639c09`

The upstream Apache 2.0 and MIT license notices are retained alongside it. This tiny fixture is for regression testing only. It is not a worldwide production geolocation database. Production users can explicitly install DB-IP City Lite through the separately documented CC BY 4.0 flow.
